text:
Shang-Chi and The Legend of The Ten Rings | Countdown to Avengers: Doomsday Official Podcast
Simu Liu has arrived! Iman Vellani and Frank Alvarez are joined by Shang-Chi himself to discuss the making of Marvel Studios’ Shang-Chi and The Legend of The Ten Rings. He brings behind-the-scenes stories about learning the fight choreography, acting alongside Sir Ben Kingsley and Tony Leung, and how the story of Shang-Chi reflects the massive changes in his own life.
